[[File:Black and White - Limited Edition Collection.png|thumb|Black & White - Limited Edition Collection]] [[File:Black and White - Limited Edition Collection angled.png|thumb|Angled cover image]] The '''Pokémon the Series: Black & White - Limited Edition Collection''' is a Region 4 DVD set that was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on October 1, 2015. This DVD set is also referred to as the '''Pokémon Black & White Collector's Set''' in promotional material. It contains four individual DVD cases with uniform covers that each contain a number of discs. Overall, the set includes 18 discs with 142 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE6367. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. It contains all of the dubbed episodes from ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]''. Specifically, it has episodes from ''[[S14|Black & White]]'', ''[[S15|Rival Destinies]]'', and ''[[S16|Adventures in Unova and Beyond]]''. ==Contents== ===Pokémon the Series: Black & White - Part 1=== [[File:Black and White Part 1.png|thumb|Part 1]] Part 1 contains all the episodes from ''[[S14|Black & White]]'' across six discs. {| class="roundy" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Unova}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Unova}}" !
